character: 70 km in the Provencal Alps. High altitude (1,630 m), sunny, good for families.
name: Pra-Loup
description: 80km of pistes, 22 lifts, also in the Ubaye valley (Alpes-de-Haute-Provence). Sunny, family-friendly, and French-focused (fewer international visitors). Known for: the lake at 1,500m (frozen in winter for skating, summer swimming), the Espace Lumière wellness centre, and excellent snowmaking. Good value, quiet slopes.
